issue_context.title: Vulkan: DirectionalLight3D PSSM 2 Splits exhibits shadow acne not present in other modes, and shadows are unstable
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 Alpha 4

### System information

Windows 11, Vulkan, Nvidia GTX 1050 Ti, 511.23

### Issue description

2 Split mode has severe Shadow Acne issues, unrelated to Shadow Resolution (both Orthogonal and 4 Split don't have Any issues in the same example) and the Shadows are unstable with 2 Splits (they jitter as the camera moves) again, unlike the other modes.

### Steps to reproduce

Switch Between Orthogonal or 4 Split Mode and 2 Split mode and Observe the differences

### Minimal reproduction project

[Bug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8283451/Bug.zip)
comments:
I can confirm this on `master` fb2802578, both with the Vulkan Clustered and Vulkan Mobile backends. This doesn't occur on `3.x` 6073277cc, both with GLES3 and GLES2.

### PSSM 2 Splits

![2022-03-17_16 50 47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/180032/158839715-75e56b68-5220-4362-adc2-86171499d2fe.png)

### PSSM 4 Splits

![2022-03-17_16 50 55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/180032/158839723-9a129962-269c-4118-ad64-d692b80f5d6d.png)

### Orthogonal

![2022-03-17_16 50 51](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/180032/158839720-274b43e5-6536-40a3-9e73-5c50808ddd15.png)

Shadow stabilization is performed here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ae312b4fd2680e8609653f8a005bf1038aa6468a/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp#L2156-L2162

There doesn't appear to be a condition for the number of splits used. However, unlike Orthogonal or PSSM 4 Splits, using PSSM with 2 splits will result in a non-square shadow map texture for each split (with the first split in the top half, and the second split in the bottom half):

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ae312b4fd2680e8609653f8a005bf1038aa6468a/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_scene_render_rd.cpp#L5186-L5193

review_comments:
I'm a little skeptical about this change. Using a multiplier of 2 makes sense since we are both adding and subtracting ``radius + soft_shadow_expand``. 

I'd expect a visual difference as you are constricting the effective size of the shadowmap. Maybe this should only be change when using 2 splits?
there was no visual difference with 4 splits so seems fine to me... though don't ask me why lol
